recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: hardcoded feature flags as quiet infrastructure
a new European AI model emerging on the horizon
sailors stepping ashore after 250 days at sea
autumn clarity over the bay at fourteen degrees
clear night wind before sunrise shipping hour

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Deploy thumb-sized agents from your phone screen to snatch code fragments floating in fog before the sunrise deadline hits.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each agent returns one fragment; stacking a full ship in under a minute feels like shipping by sunrise.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: agents spawn faster, fragments drift farther, fog thickens and hides targets
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon terminal glyphs on a pre-dawn San Francisco gradient

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick lifeboats across shifting ocean currents toward a narrowing shore after months at sea — one arc, one crew, one landing.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nailing a single perfect trajectory that carries the whole crew home in 45 seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: currents rotate, swells grow taller, the beach shrinks to a sliver
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: ink-wash nautical charts with weathered paper edges

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag boolean flag tiles into a live circuit before user traffic floods the wrong branch — hardcode the path, watch the system breathe.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: flip three flags correctly and the whole schematic lights green in one satisfying pulse
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more branches fork open, decoy paths appear, traffic volume spikes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout schematic with red/green toggle tiles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold and release to charge neural links between constellation nodes in a clear autumn sky — connect the model before clouds erase your lines.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: complete one constellation and watch it pulse alive for a 30-second payoff
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: stars drift apart, clouds sweep across drawn paths, new nodes blink into existence
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: deep blue autumn night with wireframe stars and faint aurora traces
